#!/usr/bin/python
import os
import pwd
import sys
from BaseHTTPServer import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler

CHROOT = "/srv/chroot-web-app"
PIDFILE = "/var/run/chroot-web-app.pid"
LOGFILE = "/var/log/chroot-web-app.log"
PORT = 8080

class ReusableHTTPServer(HTTPServer):
    allow_reuse_address = True

class AppHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "ChrootWebApp/1.0"
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path != "/":
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        try:
            handle = open("/var/www/index.html", "rb")
            body = handle.read()
            handle.close()
        except IOError:
            self.send_error(500)
            return
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("X-App-User", "appsvc")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

def daemonize():
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid:
        os._exit(0)
    os.setsid()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid:
        os._exit(0)
    os.chdir("/")
    os.umask(022)
    logfd = os.open(LOGFILE, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0644)
    nullfd = os.open("/dev/null", os.O_RDONLY)
    os.dup2(nullfd, 0)
    os.dup2(logfd, 1)
    os.dup2(logfd, 2)
    if nullfd > 2:
        os.close(nullfd)
    if logfd > 2:
        os.close(logfd)
    pidout = open(PIDFILE, "w")
    pidout.write(str(os.getpid()) + "\n")
    pidout.close()

def main():
    account = pwd.getpwnam("appsvc")
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "--daemon":
        daemonize()
    os.chroot(CHROOT)
    os.chdir("/")
    os.setgroups([])
    os.setgid(account.pw_gid)
    os.setuid(account.pw_uid)
    server = ReusableHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", PORT), AppHandler)
    server.serve_forever()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/bin/sh
# chkconfig: 345 85 15
# description: Chrooted unprivileged web application
# processname: chroot-web-app
. /etc/rc.d/init.d/functions

PROG=/usr/local/sbin/chroot-web-app
PIDFILE=/var/run/chroot-web-app.pid
LOCKFILE=/var/lock/subsys/chroot-web-app

start() {
    echo -n "Starting chroot-web-app: "
    if [ -r "$PIDFILE" ]; then
        oldpid=$(cat "$PIDFILE")
        if kill -0 "$oldpid" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo_success
            echo
            return 0
        fi
        rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    fi
    daemon --pidfile="$PIDFILE" $PROG --daemon
    rc=$?
    sleep 1
    if [ $rc -eq 0 ] && [ -r "$PIDFILE" ]; then
        pid=$(cat "$PIDFILE")
        if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
            touch "$LOCKFILE"
            echo
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    echo_failure
    echo
    return 1
}

stop() {
    echo -n "Stopping chroot-web-app: "
    if [ ! -r "$PIDFILE" ]; then
        echo_success
        echo
        return 0
    fi
    pid=$(cat "$PIDFILE")
    if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        kill "$pid"
        count=0
        while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null && [ $count -lt 20 ]; do
            sleep 1
            count=$((count + 1))
        done
    fi
    if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo_failure
        echo
        return 1
    fi
    rm -f "$PIDFILE" "$LOCKFILE"
    echo_success
    echo
    return 0
}

status_app() {
    if [ -r "$PIDFILE" ]; then
        pid=$(cat "$PIDFILE")
        if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "chroot-web-app (pid $pid) is running"
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    echo "chroot-web-app is stopped"
    return 3
}

case "$1" in
    start) start ;;
    stop) stop ;;
    restart) stop && start ;;
    status) status_app ;;
    *) echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}"; exit 2 ;;
esac
exit $?
